Absolutely Unacceptable Service and Zero Accountability! Look Elsewhere for Reliable Courier Services.

My recent dealings with this courier company have been nothing short of a disaster. Despite assurances of delivery, both of my parcels were marked as delivered to an entirely incorrect location. When I contacted their so-called customer service, I was met with a wall of denial and a blatant accusation that I must have provided the wrong address.

The staff showed absolutely no interest in actually helping resolve the issue. Their rigid stance and refusal to even consider their own error is frankly insulting. Instead of offering support, they simply deflected blame and told me to "check." This complete lack of responsibility and the absence of any meaningful support is simply unacceptable.

It's clear that this company's processes are flawed and their customer service is a joke. If you value your time and the safe delivery of your packages, I implore you to look elsewhere. This courier service has proven to be unreliable, unhelpful, and a complete waste of resources. Avoid them at all costs if you want to avoid similar frustration and potential loss.
